Definition: from G991; vision (properly concrete; by implication, abstract):--seeing.
BiblicalUsage: Seeing is the word for what the eyes take in, day after day — and it appears once, in the torment of Lot. In 2 Peter 2:8 the just man dwelling among the wicked, in seeing and hearing, vexed his righteous soul from day to day with their unlawful deeds. One word, for the daily wearing-down of a righteous man.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Lot's torment is the warning in this word: what we see every day shapes the soul, even when we do not join in.
